scientific_role: Fresh native fixed-cap history-state common-support falsification; not an action effect or controller study.
source_separation: Reused two licensed clips and one LTE source; M5 development excluded from validation estimates; constructed prefix plus original measured suffix; M1 synthetic separate.

transport.candidate_gathering_acceptance: Both peers complete gathering with only loopback relay candidates using relayProtocol=tcp and zero candidate errors.
transport.media_acceptance: Each scheduled block has more than ten encoded and decoded frames and finite mean encode time; each clip's SHA-256 is verified before serving.
transport.queue_acceptance: Both directions forward at least 100 packets from matching TURN allocation ports, no unexpected sources or send errors; packet and byte replay exactly matches offer/drop/service/forward ledgers; capacity and conservation checks pass.
transport.selected_pair_acceptance: Both pairs are nominated/succeeded and use TURN relay candidates over loopback with relayProtocol=tcp.
transport.trace_scheduler_acceptance: All 18 scheduled measured-rate ticks appear in order in relay events, match the frozen rates exactly, and fall within 150 ms of their registered one-second offsets.
